THE VISIONAIRE APPROACH

Great science needs
a considered space.

From a single fume hood to a complete research facility, we bring laboratory equipment, furniture and engineering together.

Established in Bengaluru in March 2007, Visionaire Lab Systems serves research centres, pilot plants and technology facilities with solutions shaped around the work that happens inside them.
